name: firewall-diag
cmd: GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 80 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 20000 --only firewall --skip broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; wc -l /tmp/err.log; cut -c1-240 /tmp/err.log | head -40; echo ...; cut -c1-240 /tmp/err.log | tail -40; exit $s
